description_en: You can call the OpenLiveShift operation to enable time shifting for a specific domain name, application, or stream
description_zh: 调用OpenLiveShift为指定域名（应用、直播流）开启时移服务
kebab_example: aliyun live open-live-shift --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: OpenLiveShift

parameters.help_en: The name of the application. The wildcard character () is supported. An asterisk () represents all applications under the specified domain name. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称。支持通配符*，代表该域名下所有的AppName。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the stream. The wildcard character () is supported. An asterisk () represents all streams under the specified application. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html
parameters.help_zh: 直播流流名称。支持通配符*，代表该AppName下所有的StreamName。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The duration of an HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) transport stream (TS) segment. Unit: seconds
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The data retention period. The default value is 7. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 表示数据保留时长。默认保留7天，单位：天
parameters.name: vision

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable time shifting for transcoded streams. Valid values:

true: Time shifting is disabled for transcoded streams.

false: Time shifting is enabled for transcoded streams.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否忽略对应转码流生成时移。取值：

true：转码流不生成时移。

false：转码流生成时移。

默认选择为true
parameters.name: ignore_transcode
